issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'שְׁלֻמִיאֵל בֶּן צוּרִֽישַׁדָּי' (Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai), but the Chinese renders '書勒米雅，是書亞大的兒子' (Shelumiel, son of Shuada). 'צוּרִֽישַׁדָּי' (Zurishaddai) is mistranslated as '書亞大' (Shuada), which is a different name. The correct rendering should be '書利沙代' or similar, not '書亞大'.
